services.title: What We Can Do For You
services.subtitle: See if any of these sound familiar
cat1.question: Data scattered everywhere? Buried in a pile of spreadsheets?
cat1.item1.title: Escape Spreadsheet Hell
cat1.item1.desc: Reports and reconciliations scattered across a dozen spreadsheets, copy-pasting until your eyes blur? We bring it into one system — enter data once, sync everywhere.
cat1.item2.title: Dashboards Your Boss Can Actually Read
cat1.item2.desc: Waiting all month for someone to compile the numbers? Get a live dashboard instead — no more manual spreadsheet roundups.
cat1.item3.title: Connect Your Existing Systems
cat1.item3.desc: Accounting software and ERP that don't talk to each other, so you type the same record three times? We connect them — enter once, sync everywhere.
cat1.item4.title: Automatic Document Recognition
cat1.item4.desc: Manually retyping every invoice and receipt, one at a time, mistakes and all? AI reads the documents and fills the data in for you.
cat1.item5.title: Cloud Backup for Your Data
cat1.item5.desc: Critical files living on one computer or someone's USB drive? We move it to the cloud — safely backed up, accessible anytime.
cat1.item6.title: Automatic Reports & Reminders
cat1.item6.desc: Forgetting contract renewals or low stock until it's too late? The system emails and notifies you automatically.
cat2.question: Drowning in customer messages? On call nights and weekends?
cat2.item1.title: AI Customer Service
cat2.item1.desc: Same questions every day, phone ringing off the hook? AI handles the first round, 24/7, so your team only deals with what really needs a person.
cat2.item2.title: LINE Official Account Bot
cat2.item2.desc: Customers messaging on LINE around the clock? A bot answers common questions and takes bookings or orders automatically.
cat2.item3.title: Company Website
cat2.item3.desc: Customers look you up and find nothing, or a ten-year-old site that doesn't work on phones? We build one that actually looks professional.
cat2.item4.title: Get Found on Google
cat2.item4.desc: Built a website but nobody can find it in search? Basic SEO so customers actually see you.
cat3.question: Typing the same form two or three times? Stuck in the back-and-forth?
cat3.item1.title: Move Forms Online
cat3.item1.desc: Sales reps still texting in paper forms for someone to retype? Move it online — enter once, no retyping.
cat3.item2.title: Booking & Scheduling System
cat3.item2.desc: Juggling appointments by phone, LINE, and walk-ins, and things keep double-booking? Let customers pick their own slot online.
cat3.item3.title: Inventory Management
cat3.item3.desc: Never sure what's actually in stock without digging through spreadsheets? Real-time, accurate numbers, with low-stock alerts.
cat3.item4.title: Multi-Location Data Sync
cat3.item4.desc: Every branch keeping its own books, HQ waiting on everyone to report in? We connect it all — HQ sees it live.
cat4.question: Too much repetitive work, but hiring more people isn't in the budget?
cat4.item1.title: Let AI Do the Repetitive Work
cat4.item1.desc: Data analysis, filing, first-pass reviews eating up your team's time? Let AI take the first pass so the same headcount gets more done.
cat4.item2.title: Automated Web Data Collection
cat4.item2.desc: Manually checking competitor prices or market rates one by one? We automate the collection and keep it updated for you.
